thread:
morgan: Quick sync — bringing up Argus-9. We're doing int6 and int4 experiments. TL;DR: int4 gives ~18% cost drop and 30% throughput bump on our chat slices, but small quality drift on long-form summarization. Need a concise unit-econ recommendation for GTN by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kai: Can you share the slice breakdown? which product signals we should prioritize for the scorecard?

morgan: product slices: short-chat(40%), multi-turn-assistant(30%), longform-summarize(20%), rerank-ish(10%). Priorities: short-chat first (latency sensitive), longform last (quality sensitive).

rui: Quick numbers from the run this morning:
- float32 baseline cost_per_1k_tokens: $2.40
- int6 variant: $1.70 (–29%), median latency +5ms, p95 +18ms
- int4 variant: $1.00 (–58%), median latency –10ms, p95 +60ms on long sequences
- eval delta (overall aggregated QA metric): int6 ≈ –0.6%, int4 ≈ –2.8% (worse on longform QA)

sophia: Noted. For multi-turn we saw context-truncation hallucination cases in int4 when prompt length > 2k tokens. Any KV-cache regressions?

rui: KV-cache microbench looked fine for short-chat. For longform, int4 increased cache misses due to tokenization quirks on system prompts — we can patch tokenization but takes a day.

morgan: Proposal for GTN:
1) Canary route: short-chat -> int4 (60%), int6 fallback (40%) if quality signal dips.
2) Multi-turn -> int6 (80%), int4 only for very small context requests (<=512 tokens).
3) Longform -> keep float32 / int6 only until we fix tokenization; run focused eval with priming variations.
4) Add quick scorecard per route: columns = unit_cost, median_latency, p95_latency, quality_delta, recommended_flag.

oliver: +1. Also add an automatic fallback when user-level error rate > 0.5% over 5m. Keep canary window 10k requests.

morgan: Agreed. I'll draft the scorecard. Example row format:```
route: short-chat
model:int4-argus-9
unit_cost:$1.00/1k
median_latency:85ms
p95_latency:210ms
quality_delta:-1.1%
recommendation:canary(60%)->monitor(priming,latency,p95)->fallback:int6
```

kai: Do we have an eval slice for 'hallucination-on-continual-context'? If not, product needs to supply a tiny prompt set.

sophia: I'll pull 150 examples from longform cases and create a lightweight hallucination check.

rui: I'll re-run int4 with the tokenization patch on a subset and post numbers by midday. Expect p95 improvement on long sequences ~20–25ms.

deploy-bot: Canary created: argus-9-int4-canary -> 10% in us-west; watch metrics /deploy status:green :rocket:

morgan: Nice. Next steps:
- rui: updated run + tokenization patch (by 12:30)
- sophia: hallucination slice (150 ex) -> 13:00
- oliver: add fallback rule in routing config (SLO threshold -> 0.5% errors)
- kai: prepare GTN one-pager with scorecard template (by EOD)

kai: I'll assemble the one-pager. Keep bullets short: cost delta, latency tail, quality risk, recommended traffic split, rollback criteria.

morgan: If int4 patch run looks good, we can widen short-chat to 60% tomorrow morning. If not, hold. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oliver: noted and will monitor SLOs.

rui: Posting updated numbers in the thread once run completes.

sophia: And I'll attach the 150-case sheet to the GTN doc after QA.

morgan: Perfect. End of thread.
